intro: Small spaces deserve big memories. The Franky table fits compact homes beautifully, with stone-inspired top and stable metal base that make family meals warm and effortless.

features.title: Sized right for modern homes
features.text: Thoughtfully proportioned for apartments and compact dining rooms, it offers a complete 4-seater setup without overwhelming your space.

features.title: Stone-inspired suede top
features.text: Crafted in moisture-resistant HMR board with a trendy stone-pattern finish, the tabletop feels modern, easy to maintain, and inviting for daily meals.

features.title: Stable frame with joining wedge
features.text: Diagonal legs supported by a custom wedge detail give the table both unique character and the strength to stay steady through everyday use.

features.title: Rounded corners for safer dining
features.text: Smoothly finished edges reduce sharpness, keeping family meals relaxed and child-friendly while maintaining a refined look.

features.title: Built for lasting value
features.text: High moisture-resistant board paired with a powder-coated metal frame ensures durability, while offering a value-for-price solution for daily dining.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
